analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 36.5 to 43.8 but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram worsened from -1.9098 to -2.1069, continuing bearish signals. Volume ratio at 1.01 is normal. Weekly RSI is 46.1 and weekly MACD histogram is -4.5360, indicating a bearish long-term trend. ADX at 21.3 suggests an early stage of trend formation, with -DI at 36.4 significantly outweighing +DI at 16.3, indicating stronger downward pressure. Considering these indicators, the current phase lacks clear directional conviction.
